question: Who among the following is related with Mohiniyattam?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kanak Rele.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam is a traditional dance form of Kerala, India, which is known for its graceful movements and expressions.**

 
 
• **Kanak Rele** is a renowned **dancer, choreographer, and scholar** who has **contributed significantly to the promotion and development of Mohiniyattam.**

 
 
• She has established the Nalanda Dance Research Centre in Mumbai, which focuses on research, training, and documentation of various Indian classical dance forms, including Mohiniyattam.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Manjit Bawa** was a famous Indian painter, while Ratan Thiyam is a well-known theatre director and playwright. Both of them are not associated with Mohiniyattam.
 
• **Shanti Dave** was a Gujarati poet and writer, who is also not related to Mohiniyattam.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informatio__**

 
• ** Manjit Bawa **was known for his vibrant and colorful paintings, which often featured animals and mythical creatures.

 
 
• **He was awarded the Padma Shri in 1984.**
 
 
 
• Ratan Thiyam is the founder-director of the Chorus Repertory Theatre in Manipur, which has produced several acclaimed plays in India and abroad.
 
 
• He has been honored with numerous awards, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan.
 
 
 
• **Shanti Dave **was a prominent figure in the Gujarati literary world, who wrote poetry, essays, and novels.
 
 
• She was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1977 for her book 'Saptapadi'.
 
 
 
• ** Mohiniyattam** is believed to have originated in the **16th century, **and it is primarily performed by women.
 
 
• It combines elements of dance, music, and theatre to tell stories from Hindu mythology and folklore. The dance form is characterized by slow, graceful movements, delicate hand gestures, and subtle facial expressions.
